prompt: Which Kiwi author died the same year as the first British Prime Minister to be elected after the end of World War 1?
answer: The Kiwi author was **Katherine Mansfield**, who died in **1923**, the same year that **Andrew Bonar Law**, the first British prime minister elected after World War I, died.
